NSCameraUsageDescription: Uni Streak uses your camera when you choose to take a photo or video for a post, a chat message, or your avatar.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Uni Streak accesses your photo library when you choose to attach an existing photo or video to a post, a chat message, or your avatar.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Uni Streak uses your microphone when you choose to record a voice message or a sound clip.
